# GSAP

Vendored GSAP core 3.13.0, including CSSPlugin; no extra plugins required.
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/gsap.min.js
Official package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap/v/3.13.0
License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/ (copyright/license header retained).

Served locally so animations do not depend on a third-party CDN at runtime.
